cohort.note: Frozen from advisory metadata only. No case source, diff or result has been read by anyone tuning rules.

arms.candidate_rule: Exactly the ruleset digest whose paired exposed qualification returned ACCEPT; its receipt SHA-256 is written here in one commit before Q2 is opened, and nothing else in this file changes in that commit.

engine.harness: scripts/recall_harness.mjs at the main commit named in the opening commit

one_shot: Q2 is scored once per arm. Any later scoring is a development run and is reported as such.
A rerun is allowed only for an infrastructure failure (engine crash, fetch failure, disk) with byte-identical inputs; the failed attempt is kept and reported.
No rule, scorer, profile or exclusion changes between opening and reporting.

metrics.primary: Strict hunk recall: a CWE-family alert on an old-side -U5 hunk line of an in-language, non-test file changed by the fix, at the fix parent. Reported as hits/282 with a Wilson 95% interval, per arm.
metrics.paired: Per-case baseline->candidate transitions; discordant pairs tested with an exact two-sided sign test.
metrics.outcomes: hit, miss, engine timeout, unknown (no in-language change, unfetchable, incomplete scan) and error, each counted; unknowns stay in the denominator as not hit.
metrics.secondary: Advisory-level recall as pre-registered in docs/RECALL_PRECISION.md (25 Nov): flagged anywhere, still flagged after fix, fix-resolved, and same-family alerts per KLOC on the 18 benign controls.
metrics.breakdowns: By ecosystem and by CWE family, descriptive only.

decision_rule.improvement_claim: Claimed only if candidate gains exceed losses with sign-test p < 0.05, and the candidate's benign-control alert count does not exceed the baseline's.
decision_rule.otherwise: Report the numbers without an improvement claim. Losses are reported by advisory ID either way.

precision.sample: Candidate alerts in Q2 changed files; fixed seed 20261127; cap 40 per rule; blinded packet with the exposed-review instructions.
precision.review: Two independent reviewer arms at matched effort and a Fable 5.2 judge on disagreements; per-family precision with Wilson 95% intervals.
precision.key_custody: The packet key and each arm's labels are withheld from the other arm and the judge until all labels are in.
precision.context: v2 supplement (context_supplement_v2.py, sha256 ba2ec5e36eef0ddd3ff08c13d444fb643bb5023bd1df72b660de6f737a9a651c; its exact bytes are committed with the opening commit or ported into scripts/verify_precision_gain.py beforehand with identical output): +/-40 lines and file header, plus, from the repository at the old-side commit, the enclosing function, definitions of helpers called near the marked line, and non-test call sites of the enclosing function. On the 39 exposed items the two arms disputed with v1 context, fresh arms with v2 context agreed on 20.

preconditions: Paired exposed qualification ACCEPT on the candidate digest: zero lost hits (or each loss span-adjudicated), zero benign-control increase, all controls complete.
Exposed precision review adjudicated (two arms + judge) for the candidate's unadjudicated alerts.
Candidate merged to main with CI green.
This file committed to main before Q2 is opened.
